Case: Patient D is an 86-year-old Asian woman with history of multiple myeloma who presents with 6 months of progressive neck pain and limb weakness. There are also innumerable osteolytic lesions throughout the visible spine segments.
Question: Would you offer morphine to Patient D? Yes or No? If yes, how much supply would you give – Low (1 week), or High (4 weeks) supply? Explain.
